Alice Chen: Hey team — urgent POC blocker for Acme demo. Customer hits 413 Request Entity Too Large when sending a single /v1/generate with a ~900k-char context. Demo is in 2 days, can someone help triage?

Raj Patel: Oof. Do you have the exact HTTP error and any proxy logs? Which endpoint (hosted/dedicated/private)?

Alice Chen: Hosted API (prod). Error from our edge: 
```
nginx/1.22.0: client intended to send too large body
upstream 502 "413 Request Entity Too Large"
request_id=rcv_01H2abc123
```
Using SDK v0.9.4, curl looks like: 
```
curl -X POST https://api.redwood.ai/v1/generate -H "Authorization: Bearer $TOKEN" -H "Content-Type: application/json" --data @big_payload.json
```
Payload is a giant concatenation of customer chat history + knowledgebase (~1.2M chars).

Maya (Solutions): Thanks for the details. Two-pronged approach: short-term workarounds for demo + long-term presales options. Short-term: 1) stream the prompt in smaller semantic chunks and stitch results on client; 2) gzip payloads with Content-Encoding: gzip (if allowed by proxy); 3) split context and do iterative retrieval + condense with summarization before generate.

Raj Patel: Can you try gzip first and see nginx error change? Also include the request_id from the edge logs (you posted rcv_01H2abc123, thanks) so oncall can trace. For token math: ~4 chars per token is a rough heuristic — so 1.2M chars ~300k tokens which is > typical model/route limits.

Eng Oncall Bot: Noted. Rate: traced request rcv_01H2abc123 -> dropped at edge (client_max_body_size). No downstream logs. If gzip encoded, edge may still reject if uncompressed size exceeds limit.

Alice Chen: Tried gzip -> curl --header "Content-Encoding: gzip" --data-binary @payload.json.gz. Edge returned same 413, log now: 
```
nginx: client intended to send too large body: 1183048 bytes (exceeded 1048576)
```
Looks like edge max body size = 1MB.

Maya (Solutions): Ok that's an edge body limit. Options: a) use our streaming API (send progressive history + model supports streaming) b) chunk inputs and use a summarization pipeline to compress context before generate c) for enterprise customers we can negotiate a proxy config or Dedicated deployment to support larger bodies. For the demo I recommend chunk+summary — faster to implement.

Kevin (Sales): FYI — Acme is exploring Reserved/Dedicated for compliance/perf. If they sign for Dedicated, we can route through a customer-specific ingress with higher body limits. I'll prep pricing impact and a short T&Cs note.

Raj Patel: Short-term technical steps to unblock demo: 1) implement client-side chunking into ~200KB pieces; 2) call a small summarize model or our /v1/summarize endpoint for each chunk; 3) concatenate summaries and send final generate call. This keeps each request <1MB. I can paste a quick pseudo-code snippet.

Maya (Solutions): Please include an example prompt for the summarizer: "Summarize the following chat history focusing on user intents and products mentioned, target length 300 tokens." That preserves semantics for the final prompt.

Alice Chen: Copying Raj's snippet now (pseudo): 
```
chunks = chunk_text(big_text, size=200000)
summaries = []
for c in chunks:
  res = POST /v1/summarize {"text": c}
  summaries.append(res.summary)
final_prompt = join(summaries) + "
User question: ..."
POST /v1/generate {"prompt": final_prompt, "max_tokens": 1024}
```
Will try and report back in ~2h.

Eng Oncall Bot: If this fails and customer needs immediate cutoff changes, please open a support ticket with request_id, sample payload (sanitized), org id, and desired body size so infra can evaluate a temporary edge rule.

Kevin (Sales): I'll draft the sales-side note offering a 30-day proof Dedicated preview if they need higher limits for the pilot — will confirm with legal. @Maya (Solutions) can you prepare a one-page technical note comparing streaming vs Dedicated for the customer?

Maya (Solutions): On it. I'll include estimated cost delta, ops changes, and implementation effort.

Alice Chen: Update — summarization approach works, final generate went through. Demo motion unblocked. Thanks everyone! :tada:

Raj Patel: Awesome. For follow-up: collect a sanitized sample of the original big_payload.json and attach to the ticket so infra can consider raising body limit for that org or enable chunked ingestion endpoint.

Kevin (Sales): Great outcome. I'll track conversion signal. If Acme engages further, we'll coordinate Dedicated onboarding and pricing.

Alice Chen: Leaving the ticket and sanitized payload in the thread (linked). Closing for now. Cheers. :beers:
